graph.title: IKEA GRÅFJÄLLET table

steps.title: Start the frame and first side panel
steps.instruction: Lay the metal frame flat on the protective surface. Slide the first side panel down into the matching slots, checking the notches match the drawing, then fasten it with two screws from underneath.
warnings: Protect the surface and do not force the panel if it is not aligned.

steps.title: Fit the second side panel
steps.instruction: Add the second side panel in the same way, sliding it into the frame slots with the cutouts facing correctly. Secure the bottom edge with two more screws.

steps.title: Fold the frame and lock the side panels
steps.instruction: Fold the connected frame section over to form the box shape around the panels. Once the edges sit square, fasten the lower corners with four screws.

steps.title: Install and lock the back panels
steps.instruction: Slide the back panel into the open frame channel, then press the four locking tabs until they click into place. Turn the unit as shown and repeat with the other back panel and four more locks.

steps.title: Attach the tabletop and upright the table
steps.instruction: Place the tabletop face down, position the assembled frame over it, and fasten the four corners with the Allen key and bolts. Screw the four round feet into the leg ends, then turn the table upright.

steps.title: Prepare the door
steps.instruction: Lay the door panel flat with its inside facing up. Fasten the handle with two screws, add the small screw and washer at the hinge edge, then press the cover cap into the remaining hole.

steps.title: Choose the door swing and fit the lower hinge pin
steps.instruction: This build follows the first door option shown, with the door opening to the right. Insert the hinge pin into the lower hinge hole on the front frame; the opposite-hand door is assembled as a mirror image.

steps.title: Hang the door and add the latch
steps.instruction: Lower the door onto the hinge pin so it sits in the bottom hinge hole. Slide the push latch upward into its bracket inside the frame, then press until it clicks and holds.

steps.title: Close the door and level the feet
steps.instruction: Swing the door closed and check that the front sits even. Adjust the four round feet by turning them until the table stands level, then remember the table is delicate and not for sitting.
warnings: Do not sit on the table or place more than 25 kg, 55 lb, on it.

notes: Assemble the GRÅFJÄLLET bedside-style table with metal frame, side panels, a hinged door, four adjustable feet, and a push latch. The door can be mounted to open either direction; this storyboard follows the first option shown and notes that the other side mirrors it.
Delicate table: do not sit on the product.
Do not place heavy objects on this product. Maximum load is 25 kg, or 55 lb.
Use a screwdriver by hand, not a power driver.
Assemble on a soft protective surface to avoid damage.
If parts are missing or damaged, contact IKEA instead of forcing assembly.
